items.truth: Style.Borders has a private setter (`public Borders Borders { get; private set; }`), so it is get-only for callers; mutate the returned Borders instead.

items.quote: - `Font`: Gets or sets the font settings.
items.truth: Style.Font has a private setter (`public Font Font { get; private set; }`); it is get-only for callers.

items.quote: The `Style` class enables formatting of cells through properties such as `Font`, `Color`, `FillPattern`, and `Border`
items.truth: Style has no Color, FillPattern or Border property; its properties are Font, Borders, Pattern (of type FillPattern), ForegroundColor and BackgroundColor.

items.quote: - `Save`: Saves the workbook to an XLSX file using default save options.
items.truth: Workbook.Save(string) switches to SaveFormat.Pdf when the file name ends in .pdf, and there are four more Save overloads (SaveFormat/SaveOptions, file or Stream), so it does not always write XLSX.

items.quote: classes to organize and sort worksheet content
items.truth: AutoFilterSortState and AutoFilterSortCondition only store sort-state metadata (Ref, Descending, SortBy, CustomList). No method sorts or reorders cell data, and FilterColumn does not hide rows.
Color is a struct and FillPattern is an enum, not classes.

items.quote: It runs on Windows, Linux, and macOS, and does not require Microsoft Excel or any native Office installation.
items.truth: Aspose.Cells.FOSS depends on SkiaSharp 2.88.8 for PDF rendering, and SkiaSharp 2.88.8 pulls native libSkiaSharp assets only for Win32 and macOS; PDF export on Linux needs SkiaSharp.NativeAssets.Linux, which the package does not declare, so the Linux / no-native-installation statement is unqualified.
items.evidence: https://api.nuget.org/v3-flatcontainer/skiasharp/2.88.8/skiasharp.nuspec dependencies group net6.0 (only NativeAssets.Win32 + NativeAssets.macOS); https://api.nuget.org/v3-flatcontainer/aspose.cells.foss/26.10.0/aspose.cells.foss.nuspec dependencies (SkiaSharp only); src/Aspose.Cells_FOSS/Aspose.Cells_FOSS.csproj:53-54@f71fe5595ebdaf16e2e0a7d7c8224f399b54c4e2; src/Aspose.Cells_FOSS/Aspose.Cells_FOSS.csproj:54@f71fe5595ebdaf16e2e0a7d7c8224f399b54c4e2 (SkiaSharp 2.88.8)
items.review_truth: This is the only item under Native and System Requirements, but the SkiaSharp 2.88.8 dependency (used by the PDF renderer) pulls native libSkiaSharp assets only for Win32 and macOS. Linux needs SkiaSharp.NativeAssets.Linux, which Aspose.Cells.FOSS does not declare, so the 'runs on Linux' claim is unqualified for PDF export.
